name: Takarai Eriko
source:
More than ten years ago, when her daughter was still young, she lost her husband. Since then, she has raised her daughter with only the slender arms of a woman. 

Dedicated to her daughter she had abandoned her womanhood without even realizing it. Recently, her daughter got married and moved out, bringing a sense of closure to her life. 

The appearance of the protagonist, who is the same age as her daughter, stimulates her motherhood and her womanhood. 

Although she is now seen by others as an old lady, her youth, though short, was spent at the height of the bubble economy, and she was a cheerful girl who enjoyed the night life.

She is reclusive and timid, but gradually regains her true self as she takes care of the main character, who has a positive attitude, and as they soon become man and woman.
